records.command: git branch --show-current && git log -1 --format='%h %s' && git log -1 --format='%h %s' codex/earshot-sound-effects && git log -1 --format='%h %s' codex/deepseek-video-agent && git merge-base main codex/earshot-sound-effects && git merge-base main codex/deepseek-video-agent && git merge-base codex/earshot-sound-effects codex/deepseek-video-agent && git worktree list --porcelain

git diff --name-status main...codex/earshot-sound-effects -- . ':!.dip' ':!.agents' ':!.claude' ':!AGENTS.md' ':!CLAUDE.md' && git diff --name-status main...codex/deepseek-video-agent -- . ':!.dip' ':!.agents' ':!.claude' ':!AGENTS.md' ':!CLAUDE.md'

git status --porcelain=v1 -z | python3 -c 'import sys,collections; a=sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b"\0"); c=collections.Counter(); rows=[]; i=0
while i<len(a):
 s=a[i].decode("utf-8","replace"); i+=1
 if not s: continue
 status=s[:2]; p=s[3:]
 if status[0] in "RC" or status[1] in "RC":
  old=a[i].decode("utf-8","replace") if i<len(a) else ""; i+=1
 else: old=""
 if p.startswith(".dip/"): c[(status,".dip")]+=1
 else: rows.append((status,p,old))
print("DIP status counts:",dict(c)); print("Other changes:")
for r in rows: print(*r)'
